name: Lang Co Beach
kicker: A long beach under the Hai Van ridge
summary: Swim and walk a gentle bay under the pass, between Hue and Da Nang. Neither the national beach page nor Visit Hue prints a ticket. Skip it if you wanted a city promenade or the citadel.
getThere: The beach is the strip if you sleep here. Minutes from Hue or Da Nang are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Fishing boats on the sand, with the ridge behind the surf
body: Swim and walk. The national beach page describes about 10 km of gentle shore, white sand, clear water, and beach games, beside Highway 1A under Hải Vân. Visit Hue describes the same bay as a resort beach, not a city promenade. The addresses on those pages still print thị trấn Lăng Cô, huyện Phú Lộc. Later official pages print xã Chân Mây - Lăng Cô.

Come in the morning or late afternoon if you want the ridge in the light. Visit Hue names summer as the season for the swim. A lifeguard hour was not printed, and a fixed visit length was not printed. Check on arrival.

Do not treat the sand as a ticketed park. Neither page prints a beach ticket. Hue, about 60 km north, is the citadel day. Da Nang is the city beach. The mistake is booking one of those when the picture you wanted was this bay at breakfast.

figures.caption: The sand spit, with the town on the lagoon side and the sea on the other
figures.alt: A long sand spit at Lang Co, town and boats on the left, open sea on the right

gettingThere: The beach is the base if you sleep on the strip. Highway 1A runs beside it. Minutes from Ga Lăng Cô or from Nguyễn Văn were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hue
legs.body: About 60 km south. The national page prints 60 km. Visit Hue prints “tầm 60 km”. Neither page prints drive minutes. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: About 25 km through the Hải Vân road tunnel, on the national beach page only. The pass road is longer, and it is the road that reaches the gate. Drive minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. Neither the national beach page nor Visit Hue prints a clock.
closed: No weekly closing day is published. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Neither the national beach page nor Visit Hue prints a beach ticket. Check on arrival if a gate asks. Hải Vân Quan is a separate fee.
